title: マイルCSの後に・キングの訓示

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My race against King in the Mile Championship is over. I feel her determination wash over me, and my love for Umamusume goes through the roof!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: King tells me to run against lots of Umamusume and become a true all-rounder! Oh, what golden words of wisdom!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've decided to run tons and tons of big races. And at the end of that grind sesh, I'm gonna take on Opera O and Doto!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Next Episode—Digitan's Training Montage! I'm gonna travel the country picking up new skills wherever I go!
